hook: Zoom out from my room to my home, street, town, state, country, continent and planet Earth, and back again. Each place shrinks into a glowing box on the next map.
outcome: Describe where I live as places inside bigger places, and tell land from water on a map
sources: Illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
US states: us-atlas v3 from US Census Bureau boundaries (public domain)
North America: Natural Earth via world-atlas 2.0.2 (public domain)
